import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF1187G extends PrintWriter {
    public CF1187G() { super(System.out); }
    
    static class Reader {
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[1 << 15];
        private int idx, len;
        private final InputStream stream;
        
        Reader(InputStream s) { stream = s; }
        
        private int nextByte() throws IOException {
            if (idx >= len) {
                len = stream.read(buf);
                idx = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[idx++];
        }
        
        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int b;
            while ((b = nextByte()) <= 32) if (b == -1) return -1;
            int n = 0;
            while (b > 32) {
                n = n * 10 + (b - '0');
                b = nextByte();
            }
            return n;
        }
    }
    
    Reader rd;
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        CF1187G solver = new CF1187G();
        solver.rd = new Reader(System.in);
        solver.solve();
        solver.flush();
    }
    
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    List<Integer>[] adjList;
    int nodeCount, edgeCount;
    int[] src, dst;
    int[] cap, cost;
    int[] dist, depth;
    
    void setup(int n, int m) {
        nodeCount = n;
        edgeCount = m;
        adjList = new ArrayList[nodeCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) adjList[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        src = new int[edgeCount];
        dst = new int[edgeCount];
        cap = new int[edgeCount];
        cost = new int[edgeCount];
        dist = new int[nodeCount];
        depth = new int[nodeCount];
    }
    
    void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity, int costVal) {
        int idx = adjList[u].size();
        adjList[u].add(adjList[v].size());
        adjList[v].add(idx);
        
        src[idx] = u;
        dst[idx] = v;
        cap[idx] = capacity;
        cost[idx] = costVal;
        
        src[idx ^ 1] = v;
        dst[idx ^ 1] = u;
        cap[idx ^ 1] = 0;
        cost[idx ^ 1] = -costVal;
    }
    
    boolean shortestPath(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(depth, 0);
        dist[s] = 0;
        
        PriorityQueue<int[]> heap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> {
            if (a[0] != b[0]) return a[0] - b[0];
            return a[1] - b[1];
        });
        heap.offer(new int[]{0, s});
        
        while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = heap.poll();
            int u = cur[1];
            int d = cur[0];
            
            if (d != dist[u]) continue;
            
            for (int e : adjList[u]) {
                if (cap[e] <= 0) continue;
                int v = dst[e];
                int newDist = dist[u] + cost[e];
                
                if (newDist < dist[v]) {
                    dist[v] = newDist;
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1;
                    heap.offer(new int[]{newDist, v});
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != INF;
    }
    
    int dfs(int u, int t, int flowLimit) {
        if (u == t || flowLimit == 0) return flowLimit;
        int pushed = 0;
        
        for (int e : adjList[u]) {
            if (cap[e] <= 0 || dist[dst[e]] != dist[u] + cost[e]) continue;
            
            int f = dfs(dst[e], t, Math.min(flowLimit, cap[e]));
            if (f > 0) {
                cap[e] -= f;
                cap[e ^ 1] += f;
                pushed += f;
                flowLimit -= f;
                if (flowLimit == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return pushed;
    }
    
    int[] minCostMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        int totalFlow = 0, totalCost = 0;
        
        while (shortestPath(source, sink)) {
            int flow = dfs(source, sink, INF);
            if (flow == 0) break;
            totalFlow += flow;
            for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
                if (dist[i] != INF) {
                    totalCost += dist[i] * (cap[i ^ 1] - cap[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < edgeCount; i += 2) {
            totalCost += cost[i] * (cap[i ^ 1]);
        }
        return new int[]{totalFlow, totalCost};
    }
    
    void solve() {
        try {
            int n = rd.nextInt();
            int m = rd.nextInt();
            int k = rd.nextInt();
            int c = rd.nextInt();
            int d = rd.nextInt();
            
            int[] special = new int[k];
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) special[i] = rd.nextInt() - 1;
            
            List<Integer>[] graph = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                int u = rd.nextInt() - 1;
                int v = rd.nextInt() - 1;
                graph[u].add(v);
                graph[v].add(u);
            }
            
            int T = k + 1;
            int totalNodes = n * T + 2;
            int source = totalNodes - 2;
            int sink = totalNodes - 1;
            
            setup(totalNodes, 2 * (k + n * (T - 1) + m * (T - 1) * 2));
            
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                addEdge(source, special[i] * T + 0, 1, 0);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                    int u = i * T + t;
                    int v = i * T + t + 1;
                    addEdge(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                    int u = i * T + t;
                    for (int neighbor : graph[i]) {
                        int v = neighbor * T + t + 1;
                        for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                            addEdge(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int u = i * T + T - 1;
                addEdge(u, sink, k, 0);
            }
            
            int[] result = minCostMaxFlow(source, sink);
            println(result[1]);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
